prompts.repair: Inspect and repair the model, validate again and report unresolved issues.
prompts.factory: Check for non-factory parts and colors, look up available factory substitutes and factory colors, and replace them at the original positions and orientations. Only address non-factory parts and colors; list any other issues in your reply without modifying them. Validate at the end.
prompts.palette: Check the current color scheme and merge similar or scattered colors into a small, coherent set of factory colors, minimizing the number of colors. Change colors only; do not add, delete, move or replace parts. List any other issues in your reply without modifying them. Finally, explain how you consolidated the colors.
